asset.name: System Knowledge Readiness MCP Contract
asset.description: Fail-closed exact-Scope evaluation and atomic bounded knowledge reads for Agents, including catalog-only authored-asset curation.
asset.idempotency: Identical caller, query, policy, and waterlines reuse one immutable receipt.
asset.rateLimit: Bounded by Profile asset, relationship, byte, and execution budgets.
asset.compatibilityPolicy: Gated v1 is additive; DESIGN_CATALOG_CURATION is catalog-only and does not weaken source-dependent Profiles. Legacy reads migrate through explicit observe and enforce modes.

en.name: System Knowledge Readiness MCP Contract
en.description: Fail-closed exact-Scope evaluation and atomic bounded knowledge reads for Agents, including catalog-only authored-asset curation.
en.idempotency: Identical caller, query, policy, and waterlines reuse one immutable receipt.
en.rateLimit: Bounded by Profile asset, relationship, byte, and execution budgets.
en.compatibilityPolicy: Gated v1 is additive; DESIGN_CATALOG_CURATION is catalog-only and does not weaken source-dependent Profiles. Legacy reads migrate through explicit observe and enforce modes.

zh.name: 系统知识可信读取 MCP 契约
zh.description: 面向 Agent 的失败关闭、精确 Scope 评估与原子有界知识读取契约，包含仅目录的已编写资产编排。
zh.authType: 精确应用服务 knowledge:consume 授权
zh.idempotency: 相同调用者、查询、策略和来源水位复用同一不可变回执。
zh.rateLimit: 受 Profile 的资产数、关系数、字节数和执行时间预算约束。
zh.compatibilityPolicy: 门禁 v1 采用增量兼容；DESIGN_CATALOG_CURATION 仅用于目录，不会削弱依赖源码的 Profile。旧读取通过显式 observe 和 enforce 模式迁移。

asset.name: System Knowledge Readiness Receipt
asset.description: Immutable caller-, policy-, selector-, and waterline-bound trust decisions retained in PostgreSQL.
relationships: One receipt binds one exact Scope, caller grant, Profile, selector digest, policy version, and source generation.
constraints: Receipts are immutable and reused only while unexpired and waterline-current.
Scope overlays can tighten but never weaken the enterprise minimum.
asset.lifecycle: Created after evaluation, ACTIVE until expiry or waterline invalidation, then retained according to policy.
asset.lineage: Published Baseline, connector snapshots, catalog and relationship waterlines, reconciliation, and caller grant.

zh.name: 系统知识可信读取回执
zh.description: 持久化在 PostgreSQL 中并绑定调用者、策略、选择条件和水位的不可变可信判定。
zh.lifecycle: 评估后创建，在过期或来源水位失效前为 ACTIVE，之后按策略保留。
zh.lineage: 来源于已发布 Baseline、连接器快照、目录与关系水位、对账结果和调用者授权。
relationships: 一条回执绑定一个精确 Scope、调用者授权、Profile、选择条件摘要、策略版本和来源代次。
constraints: 回执不可变，仅在未过期且来源水位当前时复用。
Scope 覆盖只能收紧企业最低要求，不能削弱它。

asset.name: Fail-Closed System Knowledge Consumption Rule
asset.description: Permits Agent use only when the exact Profile satisfies its declared evidence and reconciliation guard.
asset.condition: An Agent requests deterministic system knowledge for an exact application-service Scope.
asset.action: Evaluate the registered Profile and return assets only for a current SELF_CONTAINED receipt; catalog curation accepts only a complete current catalog and never represents source-code understanding.
asset.exception: Governance diagnostics require knowledge:diagnostic and are marked DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY.
examples: Pending source drift returns SOURCE_CHECK_REQUIRED with no asset body.
An unresolved conflict returns BLOCKED with no asset body.

zh.name: 系统知识失败关闭读取规则
zh.description: 仅在精确 Profile 满足声明的证据与对账门禁时，允许 Agent 使用 SpecForge。
zh.action: 评估已注册 Profile，仅在当前回执为 SELF_CONTAINED 时返回资产；目录编排只接受完整且当前的目录，不得表述为已经理解源码。
zh.condition: Agent 针对精确应用服务 Scope 请求确定性系统知识。
zh.exception: 治理诊断需要 knowledge:diagnostic 授权，并始终标记为 DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY。
examples: 来源漂移待处理时返回 SOURCE_CHECK_REQUIRED，且不返回资产正文。
存在未解决冲突时返回 BLOCKED，且不返回资产正文。

decisions.status: Implemented and locally verified in the exact Designer Scope; catalog-only Feature curation is an additive Profile and live Feature apply is pending its receipt-bound dry-run.
decisions.reason: Agents need an auditable fail-closed proof before treating SpecForge as the sole source for current system knowledge, while authored Feature curation needs a distinct catalog-only boundary that does not pretend source-code completeness.
decisions.retryTrigger: Open a new exact-Scope design session when Profile requirements, policy semantics, permissions, or read contracts change.
